title.en: List the demo devices, the operation vocabulary and the recipes a hub can plan

goal.en: Three catalog calls give you everything a dry run works with: capability documents by id, the fifty-seven operations with their envelopes and sensor ladders, and the recipe ids the hub holds.

note.en: Six capability documents: the example arm and the five presets of the home-page demo.
The operation vocabulary. Deep frying has a one-rung ladder; simmering is water at 85 to 96 degC.
The nine example recipes, sorted by id.

outcome.en: You can look up any operation envelope by index or id and any device by its file name. Next: scenario 009 asks the sensor ladder which rung a device can satisfy.
